# OpenOntology 0.3.0-alpha.6

Native browse and verification now report the same canonical source catalog
digest for an Object Ont. Previously, verification used a digest of its internal
source projection under the same field name. The source cut and exact evidence
were bound, but consumers comparing catalog metadata saw a mismatch.

Standalone evidence sessions retain their existing digest format. This does
not add new query verbs or change source content.

## Upgrade

Rebuild or omit derived seed-search adapters that carry the old route-map digest.
Stale adapters refuse with `SOURCE_NATIVE_SEED_SEARCH_ADAPTER`; there is no silent
raw fallback. This correction does not rewrite source artifacts or canonical
Admission records.

Node 24 or later is required:

```bash
npm install https://github.com/Doss-com/openontology/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.6/oont-0.3.0-alpha.6.tgz
```

The release includes the package archive, `SHA256SUMS`, source inventory and a
GitHub build attestation. Check the downloaded archive before installation:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify oont-0.3.0-alpha.6.tgz --repo Doss-com/openontology
```

This is a GitHub prerelease, not an npm-registry publication or managed deployment.
